segments.normalizedSource: ```swift import UIKit class MyViewController: UIViewController { let myButton = UIButton(frame: CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 100, height: 50)) override init(nibName nibNameOrNil: NSNib.Name?, bundle nibBundleOrNil: Bundle?) { super.init(nibName: nibNameOrNil, bundle: nibBundleOrNil) let action = #selector(MyViewController.tappedButton) myButton.addTarget(self, action: action, forControlEvents: .touchUpInside) } @objc func tappedButton(_ sender: UIButton?) { print("tapped button") } required init?(coder: NSCoder) { super.init(coder: coder) } } ```

segments.normalizedSource: ```swift class Person: NSObject { @objc var name: String @objc var friends: [Person] = [] @objc var bestFriend: Person? = nil init(name: String) { self.name = name } } let gabrielle = Person(name: "Gabrielle") let jim = Person(name: "Jim") let yuanyuan = Person(name: "Yuanyuan") gabrielle.friends = [jim, yuanyuan] gabrielle.bestFriend = yuanyuan #keyPath(Person.name) // "name" gabrielle.value(forKey: #keyPath(Person.name)) // "Gabrielle" #keyPath(Person.bestFriend.name) // "bestFriend.name" gabrielle.value(forKeyPath: #keyPath(Person.bestFriend.name)) // "Yuanyuan" #keyPath(Person.friends.name) // "friends.name" gabrielle.value(forKeyPath: #keyPath(Person.friends.name)) // ["Yuanyuan", "Jim"] ```
